objective_conflict.interpretation: Most remaining41p loss cannot be removed by equilibrium heads while z stays frozen. Per-input optimum can bias equilibrium to compensate fixed-rate error; simply extending same training is not justified.

same_feature_room.interpretation: Actual float32 materialized heads on independent anchors show substantial unused same-feature accuracy for Im/SK. This refutes a blanket capacity explanation for these coefficients only, not all channels or timing.

recommended_next_step: Do not expand architecture or extend the same Adam loss first. Evaluate saved direct-fit checkpoints diagnostically on GPU, and contrast fixed versus learnable K_Pst update/appropriately matched trajectory objective. Separate equilibrium accuracy from compensation of frozen z; protect old cases. No deployment or selection from41q.
